title: Bound Core harness MCP stdio response waits
goal: Prevent an unresponsive MCP stdio child from holding a harness worker forever while preserving notification skipping and sequential JSON-RPC responses.

results.change: StdioTransport owns a reader worker, bounds each response with a configurable deadline (60 seconds by default), and kills/reaps an unresponsive child before returning a timeout; notification skipping and sequential responses are preserved.
results.acceptance: cargo test --offline --locked -p susi-harness --lib mcp: 22 passed, 0 failed; full susi-harness library: 548 passed, 0 failed
results.boundary: Core harness MCP stdio lifecycle only; no dependency, Commercial, harvest, release, or credential changes
results.limitation: The process-backed timeout and response tests are Unix-only because the current host is Linux; the production implementation uses std::process and std::sync primitives without Unix APIs.
